added: Add a piece of gear to My Gear by hand, without putting it in a list first.
Edit anything in My Gear in place: weight, name, gear type, calories, product link.
What you correct in My Gear sticks: your lists stop overwriting a field once you've fixed it there.
Sort My Gear by weight, by name, or by how often you pack something, and narrow it to one kind of gear.
changed: My Gear searches the way the item autocomplete does, so a typo still finds your tent.
My Gear shows every weight in the same unit, so a column of gear reads at a glance.
My Gear moved out of the site footer. It's in the account menu, and the editor's gear panel opens the full page.
fixed: In My Gear, the folder menu on a group's last row was cut off by the group's own edge.
